summary: Intro to the guide on Ansible command-line tools, covering ad hoc commands and utilities, and pointing to Ansible Navigator as a TUI that can run content inside execution environments.
questions: Is there a text UI alternative to the plain Ansible command-line tools?
What tool lets me run Ansible content inside execution environment containers?

answer_card.title: Ansible CLI tools and Ansible Navigator
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible ships ad hoc commands and several CLI utilities for automation tasks. **Ansible Navigator** is a command-line tool and TUI that wraps most native Ansible utilities and can run automation content inside containers (Execution Environments).
